title: migrate: merge can drop the only reusable auth key
description: Real port of pgpkeys af88128: 1 person has two keys; port chooses the newest unexpired (ponytail rule in port), which has no auth key, and merges away the older key that has a reusable auth subkey. Their draft gets 0 SSH keys. Continuity's auth-key path checks only the migratedFrom key's auth keys, so pre-filling from the merged key would not prove continuity. Options for Mark: (a) prefer, among unexpired keys, one with a reusable auth key; (b) leave it (the holder can edit migratedFrom before signing, as the ponytail comment says). Affects 1 of 614.
